phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Computing & Math Foundations — Build programming skills, explore AI careers, and develop mathematical reasoning.

milestones.label: Explore artificial intelligence career pathways
milestones.description: Survey of computer science with emphasis on AI applications including machine learning, natural language processing, computer vision, robotics, and autonomous systems. Students complete introductory Python programming projects.

milestones.label: Master programming fundamentals for AI
milestones.description: Object-oriented programming in Python and C++ with emphasis on data manipulation, numerical computing, and software design patterns used in AI/ML systems.

milestones.label: Build linear algebra and calculus foundations
milestones.description: Calculus foundations essential for understanding gradient descent, optimization, and the mathematical underpinnings of neural networks and machine learning algorithms.

milestones.label: Join AI/ML student club or Google GDSC
milestones.description: Join the AI/ML student club, Google Developer Student Club, ACM chapter, or NSBE. Participate in Kaggle competitions, AI workshops, and reading groups on recent AI papers.

milestones.label: Study discrete mathematics for AI
milestones.description: Logic, set theory, combinatorics, graph theory, and proof techniques. Mathematical foundations for algorithm design, knowledge representation, and AI reasoning systems.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Data Structures & Statistical Learning — Master algorithms, probability, and introduction to machine learning.

milestones.label: Master data structures and algorithms
milestones.description: Arrays, linked lists, trees, graphs, hash tables, and algorithm complexity. Foundation for implementing efficient ML pipelines, search algorithms, and optimization routines.

milestones.label: Study probability and statistics for AI
milestones.description: Probability theory, Bayesian inference, statistical distributions, hypothesis testing, and regression. The statistical foundation for machine learning, prediction, and uncertainty quantification.

milestones.label: Compete in first Kaggle competition
milestones.description: Form a team and compete in a Kaggle data science competition. Apply data preprocessing, feature engineering, and basic ML models to a real-world prediction problem.

milestones.label: Master linear algebra for AI
milestones.description: Vector spaces, matrix operations, eigenvalues/eigenvectors, SVD, and PCA. The mathematical backbone of neural networks, dimensionality reduction, and recommender systems.

milestones.label: Introduction to machine learning
milestones.description: Supervised and unsupervised learning, decision trees, SVMs, k-means, and neural networks. Students implement ML algorithms from scratch and apply scikit-learn to real datasets.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: Deep Learning & AI Specialization — Master neural networks, NLP, computer vision, and gain professional experience.

milestones.label: Master deep learning and neural networks
milestones.description: Convolutional neural networks, recurrent neural networks, transformers, GANs, and reinforcement learning. Students implement deep learning models using PyTorch and train on GPU clusters.

milestones.label: Study natural language processing
milestones.description: Text processing, word embeddings, language models, sentiment analysis, machine translation, and large language models (LLMs). Students build NLP applications using Hugging Face and spaCy.

milestones.label: Contribute to AI research lab or open-source project
milestones.description: Join a faculty AI research lab or make meaningful contributions to an open-source AI project (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face). Build a public portfolio of AI research and code.

milestones.label: Complete summer AI/ML internship
milestones.description: Secure and complete an internship at a tech company, AI startup, or research lab working on machine learning, data science, or AI engineering projects.

milestones.label: Study computer vision and robotics
milestones.description: Image processing, object detection, semantic segmentation, 3D vision, and robotic perception. Students build computer vision systems using OpenCV and deep learning frameworks.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Capstone AI Project & Career Launch — Complete senior AI project, build portfolio, and launch AI career.

milestones.label: Execute senior capstone AI project
milestones.description: Complete a year-long AI project addressing a real-world challenge. Teams design, train, evaluate, and deploy an AI system. Projects are presented to faculty and industry reviewers.

milestones.label: Study AI ethics and responsible AI
milestones.description: Algorithmic bias, fairness, transparency, privacy, and the societal impact of AI systems. Students analyze real AI deployment cases and develop responsible AI frameworks.

milestones.label: Serve as peer mentor and AI community leader
milestones.description: Mentor underclassmen in AI/ML coursework, lead AI club activities, organize Kaggle teams, and host AI paper reading groups and workshops.

milestones.label: Develop AI career placement portfolio
milestones.description: Assemble a career launch package including GitHub portfolio with ML projects, Kaggle profile, research papers, model deployments, and documented professional network in AI industry.

milestones.label: Complete exit assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoE AI Exit Assessment demonstrating competency across program outcomes. Finalize career activation documenting job offers, graduate admissions, or research fellowship placements.
